limitations: Declared-library matching proves only calls whose CFG metadata names contain a library declared in the same normalized source; it can undercount using-for calls, imported libraries, aliases, and metadata-normalization variants.
Transfer/send name matching does not by itself distinguish Ether address operations from token-interface methods.
Type-11 presence and source regexes are representation diagnostics, not vulnerability truth or label authority.
Token retained ratio is diagnostic only and has no current adequacy threshold.
lineage_note: repository_head identifies the checked-out base; audit_script_sha256 binds the exact audit implementation because the report may be generated before its documentation tranche is committed
